summary.topic: Preparation of a fishing bait (massinha) for 'pesca do tio Paulo' (Uncle Paulo's fishing)

steps: Mix saffron with flour to create a dough (massinha)
Cook the dough until it reaches the right consistency (avoid overcooking to maintain color and texture)
Lighting affects the final color of the bait (saffron's hue is emphasized under certain light conditions)

usage.application: Used as bait for fishing in the region

summary.storage: Proper storage is recommended to maintain the bait's effectiveness
